memoryBuilder.verseText: Ruth said: 'Your people will be my people. Your God will be my God.'

sequence.prompt: How did Ruth find a home? Put it in order.

items.label: Naomi and Ruth were left with nobody
Ruth said, 'Where you go, I will go'
Ruth gathered leftover grain all day
Boaz was kind, and Ruth got a family

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Stayed with Naomi and chose her God
Went back home with nothing left
Noticed Ruth and left extra grain

application.question: Ruth came from far away and God gave her a family. Who do you know who might feel left out?
application.followUp: Ruth was from the wrong country and had nothing at all — and she ended up in Jesus' own family. Nobody is too different to belong to God.
